data.name: Flip A Coin!
data.description:
Welcome to Flip A Coin! 

💰 Flip coins to earn money!
🍀 Land on Heads to win big!
📈 Buy powerful upgrades to increase your earnings!
🔥 Build massive streaks for bonus rewards!
🎁 Get crate drops and open them for awesome rewards!
🎨 Unlock cool coin skins and table skins to customize your setup!
🏆 Compete on the Leaderboards and prove your luck and strategy!

✨ Simple to play, hard to master — every flip counts!
Will luck be on your side, or will you flip your way to the top?

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite to support the game!
💬 Join the community and stay tuned for future updates!

⚠️ Exploiting or unfair methods are not allowed and will result in a permanent ban.
